options.name: archive
options.description: Chown copied files to the primary uid/gid of the destination container.

options.name: container
options.description: Name/ID of the container to copy from/to

options.name: dest
options.description: Path of the destination file/folder to copy from/to the container

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(podman) executable if it is not in the C($PATH) on the machine running C(podman)

options.name: from_container
options.description: Specify whether or not the file must be copied from the container to the host

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Allow to overwrite directories with non-directories and vice versa

options.name: src
options.description: Path of the file/folder to copy from/to the container
